changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6475-gantt-block-face-declared.md`

- names `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` → `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The `gantt` nested-block spelling of a gantt config (`{ type: 'object-gantt', gantt: { … } }`) had **no mirror entry at all**: it rode through `BaseSchema`'s `.passthrough()` entirely unvalidated, and the published TypeScript never taught the shape either — an author writing `gantt: { … }` got no completion, no type checking, no error on a misspelt member. It was the 28th and last of the keys `getGanttConfig` (`plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`) reads off the schema that objectui#6051 (PR #6472) did not declare — severed into its own card because, unlike the other 27, declaring it changes what a published tool refuses.

### `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md`

- names `en.ts` → `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — edited by this change

  > Three new strings — the launcher's and the menu's accessible names, and the menu's empty state — are declared under `console.nav` in `en.ts` and its nine sibling packs. An inline `defaultValue` alone is not a fix: it renders English at one call site and leaves the string untranslatable everywhere (objectui#3517).

### `.changeset/6939-objectql-record-source-refinement.md`

- names `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` → `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both renderers resolve their records from one of three keys, in this order — `getDataConfig` in `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` and `plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`: `data`, then `staticData`, then `objectName`. Both mirrors required `objectName` alone, so a document authored on `staticData` drew correctly and was refused by `safeValidateSchema` — six catalog entries, three per component.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `111fa4c94` (merge-base with origin/main): 14 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1427 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2009 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36108719276)

### ① Derived judgments

**Head confirmed.** `git rev-parse refs/review/pr-10539` = `c1041d311…`; merge-base with main = `efbf18de5`; 2 commits on the branch (`68e742a16` test-only, +288 lines = the new 7237 pin file only; `c1041d311` the fix). 15 files, +502/-48, matches the PR body.

**A′ as ruled (5749198903), read against the diff:**
- Initial load keeps the placeholder: `loadedOnceRef` starts false, the fetch effect calls `reloadRef.current(loadedOnceRef.current ? { inPlace: true } : {})`; the `{}` run takes `setLoading(true)` and the untouched `if (loading)` early return (head line 2020) still returns the placeholder. Pin (d) controls this and would go red if the ref started true.
- Later real change: `loadedOnceRef` flips only inside the two `isCurrent()` commit branches (head 820, 910), so a query change BEFORE the first paint still runs non-in-place; after paint every effect run is `inPlace` ⇒ `setRefreshing(true)`, `loading` never flips again, `GanttView` stays mounted. Visible state: `RefreshIndicator active=refreshing ariaLabel=t('gantt.aria.refreshing')` inside the chart pane, which gained `relative` (the component's own doc requires a positioned ancestor). Source read of `GanttView.tsx` (root `relative`, line 3634) and `ResourceWorkload.tsx` (rows `position: relative`) confirms no absolute child re-anchors; `NavigationOverlay` is a Sheet portal.
- Dependency lists byte-identical: `diff` of both `}, [adapterInputsKey…` lines base vs head is empty (reload deps base 927 / head 951; effect deps base 975 / head 1011).
- Races: sequence guard unchanged (`seq`/`isCurrent`), `setData`/`setRowCeiling`/`setError` all gated by `isCurrent()`, so a stale response cannot commit; the objectui#7231 `finally` still clears BOTH flags when current (head 936-940). `refreshing` cannot stick: the newest reload is always current at its own `finally`. Unmount mid-flight: identical to base (no mounted-ref on either tree; React 18 no-ops). One narrow edge, non-blocking: the "a failed changed query is reported" guarantee holds only while the changed query is the NEWEST reload. Because the chart now stays mounted during the refresh, a silent reload (write-readback after a drag, or the invalidation bus) can supersede it; if the changed query then fails it is dropped (`else if (isCurrent())` false), and if that silent run also fails the previous query's rows remain with only a `console.error`. Double-failure ordering; not reachable on base only because base tore the chart down. Worth a line in the acceptance notes, not a stop.
- Route deviation (in place, not silent): the ruling's execution line says "every reload after the first is silent with a refreshing state", but its body defines the observable as no teardown, visible refreshing state, rows replaced when the query returns; the card body itself names the stale-rows lie. The dev split `silent` (failure keeps last good rows) from `inPlace` (mount kept) and kept failure reporting for a changed query. That preserves every observable the ruling names and hides nothing; AGENTS.md #0.1 is about renderer-side metadata fallbacks and is not the governing rule here, but the repo's written stance against silent false-greens (§9) points the same way. Accepted as consistent with the ruling, not a contradiction. Pinned (the "failed re-query reports the error" case); Leg 4 is the dev's own words, not re-run here. Cost: a failed changed query lands on the pre-existing never-clearing error screen, exactly as a failed non-silent one did on base.
- objectui#7231 test rewrite, per cell: `it(` 3 → 4, `expect(` 23 → 41, all three base case names kept. Case 1 moved its overlap pre-paint (both runs hold `loading`); every base assertion kept (placeholder up, stale settle does not release it, `gantt-view` null, fresh settle paints fresh rows, stale rows absent). Case 2 control: `waitFor(gantt-view)` then `getByText(fresh)` became `waitFor(getByText(fresh))` (equivalent, the row renders inside the mocked view) plus a new `data-refreshing=false` assertion. Case 3 rebuilt pre-paint via `notifyDataChanged` (silent) then a query change (non-silent); all base assertions kept, plus indicator null and the mount load answering last. New 1b twin: both runs hold `refreshing`; after the stale settle it asserts `data-refreshing=true` and the indicator present, so an unguarded `finally` would fail it. Nothing weakened or deleted. Three other gantt tests reference the placeholder (`invalidationRefetch-10035`, `contractEnvelope-6839`, `referenceArms-6837`); none encodes the post-paint teardown.
- Pins red on base for the right reason: base has `RefreshIndicator` count 0 in `ObjectGantt.tsx` and every effect reload was non-silent, so (a) remounts `GanttView` (instance id changes) and (b) has no indicator; zh red because the key did not exist. The pin commit is base source + the one new test file, as claimed.
- i18n: key in `GANTT_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` ('Refreshing…') and under `gantt.aria` in all 10 packs; scripted compare of each pack's `list.refreshing` to its new `gantt.aria.refreshing`: 10/10 SAME. `useGanttTranslation` resolves host-first per key, so zh yields 刷新中… (pinned, with a not-equal-to-English guard). Key parity is owned by `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`; `check:i18n-keys` is the call-site gate (dev reports exit 0; own words).
- Overlap: objectui#10534's locale hunks sit at `@@ -3567…-3968`; this PR's at 772…941: disjoint. `/pulls/10425` returns Not Found and no open PR mentions 10425; the other 12 open PRs touch no locale pack and no `plugin-gantt/src` file. Main has 7 commits since merge-base and none touches any of the 15 files.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/config.json`: one `fixed` group of 40 containing both `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` and `@object-ui/i18n`, so the group takes the highest declared bump either way. AGENTS.md §9 forbids only `major` (Changeset Bump Policy: success). `minor` on plugin-gantt is defensible: a new user-visible busy state (the card's facet ④ calls it a new declared surface) shipped as `feat`; precedent cuts the other way too (objectui#10035's in-place invalidation reload on plugin-gantt was `patch`), so `patch` would also have been consistent; not a blocker. `patch` on i18n matches precedent: of 24 i18n CHANGELOG paragraphs mentioning new keys, 21 sit under Patch Changes. Changeset prose, sentence by sentence: sort/filter/permissions/search/bound source are all in the effect's dependency list; scroll/collapsed groups/inline edit survive because `GanttView` is not remounted; "same `RefreshIndicator` that `ObjectGrid`, `ListView` and `ObjectChart` draw" verified by grep (ObjectGrid.tsx:5691, ListView.tsx:4828, ObjectChart.tsx:1516); the bar also shows on silent re-reads because `silent` implies `inPlace`; "the only sign of them was a disabled refresh button" true (GanttView.tsx 3526-3528, `disabled`/`aria-busy`); "a changed query that fails is still reported" true when it is the newest reload (edge above); "only a re-read of the same query keeps its last good rows" true; the i18n sentence true. No false sentence.

- Class-a finding is real at source and pre-existing: `setError` is called only on failure (base line 896, head 920) and `setError(null)` appears nowhere in either tree, so after one failed load a later successful reload still renders the error screen. Not created or worsened here; it is the screen a failed in-place changed query now lands on.

- PR is a draft, assignees empty (the dev's assign write was refused), labels plugin / tests / package: i18n. Body line 1 `Fixes #7237`, line 2 `Clause-②: yes`, both correct for the last half.
- Nothing stops landing. Non-blocking notes for the seat: the superseded-failure edge in ①; a bound-source switch on a painted chart now keeps the old object's rows under the bar during the schema-gate window (dev's acceptance note; no shipped host does this without a key remount). Merge only once the 10 in_progress checks conclude.
